note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its order-of-documents clause, the annexes and their priority numbers are generic placeholders. The stack follows only the supplied numbers (lowest on top; ties keep the annex numbering); exactly one supplied datum is substituted (the focus annex's priority number) and only the dependent geometry (that binder's level) follows. No interpretation doctrine, no conflict rule, nothing prevails beyond the supplied numbers, no jurisdiction. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): definitions; clauses = the supplied order-of-documents clause, schedules = the annexes, priorities = the supplied priority number of each annex; focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are exposed.
